column3: For me to become her manager again and help out on her stage performance.
Incidentally, Kanako is changing clothes right now.
...Really, this is turning out pretty weird.
Why am I at such a place, waiting for "my sister's friend" to finish changing...
I got bored waiting, so I started talking to Kanako as she changed clothes.
Why did you call me out?
You should know well that I'm completely useless.
When you weren't here, I did a few performances, but.
Come to think of it, this is the second time this month you are doing a Meruru performance.
Yup, a new series is starting or something.
She's here, in the waiting room next to this.
Why are there separate waiting rooms?
Hmm... Isn't it strange? You two were always together up till now.
...You're so noisy. It doesn't matter, does it?
Do you want to meet Bridget that much? You're really a lolicon after all.
What is she getting angry about?
You're the person most suited for that outfit in the entire world.
Pretty much～. Hehe... Don't praise me so much～, I'll get embarrassed.
Although Meruru is an elementary school student.
Despite how it looks, I have actually grown!
Kanako came closer slowly to show off her entire body.
How could she do something like that while wearing such erotic clothes?
That's why I said she's a brat.
In her case, there's no sense of eroticism at all, but...
If someone sees this scene, there would surely be a huge misunderstanding.
Your breasts have grown, haven't they?
The power of milk is AWESOOOOOOOOOOME!! Yeah, yeah...!
This is where Kanako's growth spurt starts... Haha♪ Just watch you guys, hehehe.
I'm so happy... Haha♪ Well, although it's still... small...
Y-you bastard, where are you looking?!
Don't say it so bluntly! You lolicon!
Who are you accusing of being a lolicon?
I have no interest in flat girls.
Well then, I'll confirm if it's true or not.
W-Where are you making me touch, you......?!
Hehe, you got shaken, didn't you?
You don't have any interest in a loli girl like me, right?
Or are you really a lolicon?
Hey... Kyousuke... Do you hate me?
...How is it possible... I'm definitely not supposed to be a lolicon!
Damn it! Yet why does my heart beat faster when Kanako comes closer...?!
What's with that face? Did you take it seriously?
Getting that flustered, you're so cute♪ Are you really a lolicon after all?
Kanakana-chan, it's about time to go on stage... Eh...
I'm busy at the moment, so wait for me a little.
B-Bridget-chan... It's not what it seems; there's an explanation for this...?!
Hey! Get up! If we don't chase after her, there will definitely be a misunderstanding!
It doesn't matter, let her misunderstand.
Rather, how about making it the real thing?
...The things that happened before, what just happened... You might have thought that I was teasing you all the while.
I can't do those kinds of things.
From the sudden confession, my brain without so much as a spin, reached boiling point.
The sincere words that spilled from Kanako's mouth made my heart melt.
...Do you remember when we first met?
...It felt like the worst possible meeting.
You said terrible things like I'm plain, and that I seemed like I'd be a section manager at a small company in ten years.
I still feel the same way now.
How it turned out this way... I really don't know.
...Looks like I've become a serious lolicon bastard after all.
As I look at Kanako's shy and completely red face,
......My little sister's friend can't be this cute.
